- Search Google using Serper API - performs real-time web searches with high-quality results
- Provides up-to-date information for current events, recent data, and factual queries
- Returns organic search results, knowledge graphs, and "People Also Ask" sections
- Supports configurable result counts, country codes, and language codes
- Use this tool for accessing information beyond your knowledge cutoff
- Searches are performed automatically within a single API call

Usage notes:
  - Requires SERPER_API_KEY environment variable to be set
  - Supports country code (gl) for region-specific results (e.g., 'us', 'in', 'uk')
  - Supports language code (hl) for language-specific results (e.g., 'en', 'hi', 'es')
  - Returns structured results including organic links, knowledge graphs, and related questions
  - Default number of results is 10, configurable via numResults parameter

The current year is {{year}}. You MUST use this year when searching for recent information or current events.
- Example: If the current year is 2026 and the user asks for "latest AI news", search for "AI news 2026", NOT "AI news 2025"
